briefTitle: A Study of NT-175 in Adult Participants With Advanced Malignancies That Are Positive for HLA-A*02:01 and the TP53 R175H Mutation

typedChecks.sourceText: Subjects must be at least 18 years of age
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Subjects must be at least 18 years of age

typedChecks.sourceText: Subject has advanced solid cancer, defined as unresectable, advanced, and/or metastatic disease (Stage III or IV) after at least 1 line of approved systemic standard of care (SOC) treatment regimen and for which there are no available curative treatment options.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subject must be diagnosed with one of the histologies below: NSCLC, Colorectal adenocarcinoma, HNSCC, Pancreatic adenocarcinoma, Breast cancer, Ovarian cancer, Any other solid tumor
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Includes multiple diverse solid tumors and other cancer types, not representable as a standard NSCLC-specific histology list.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Tumors must harbor a TP53 R175H variant mutation and subject must be HLA-A*02:01 positive (at least 1 allele)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: TP53 R175H and HLA-A*02:01 do not have designated typed check kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subject has at least 1 measurable lesion
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known, active primary central nervous system (CNS) malignancy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Wording specifies active primary CNS malignancy, which does not map cleanly to standard brain_mets categories.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subject must be diagnosed with one of the histologies below: NSCLC, Colorectal adenocarcinoma, HNSCC, Pancreatic adenocarcinoma, Breast cancer, Ovarian cancer, Any other solid tumor
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Includes multiple tumor types across different organs, some of which are not standard NSCLC histologic categories.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Tumors must harbor a TP53 R175H variant mutation and subject must be HLA-A*02:01 positive (at least 1 allele)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: No typed kind for TP53 variants or HLA status.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subject has at least 1 measurable lesion
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable lesion is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate hematological, renal, hepatic, pulmonary, and cardiac function
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General organ function statement without specific lab cutoffs.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known, active primary central nervous system (CNS) malignancy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Primary CNS malignancy is not a standard brain_mets check for secondary metastases.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Systemic therapy within at least 2 weeks or 3 half-lives, whichever is shorter, prior to enrollment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window is condition-dependent and complex.
